text.en:
Today you learn to say what is in a place.
There is a lift.
It means: a lift is here.
There are stairs.
It means: you can find stairs here.

One thing: There is.
More than one: There are.
There is a toilet upstairs.
There are eggs in the fridge.
To ask, put Is or Are first.
Are there lockers at the station?
To say none, add no.
There is no sugar left.

You will say what is where, and ask about it.
You will also say that there is none.
Look: one thing or many? Pick is or are.
There is no signal here.
Are there any blankets?
